# Location and yearly status {#sec-dd-location}


::: {.cell}

:::


## Overview

The only location in the data is the **postcode area** of the testing station
where the vehicle had its MOT test in each year: `LS` for Leeds, `B` for
Birmingham, and so on. It is where the vehicle was tested, which is usually,
but not always, near where it is kept. @sec-geography explains postcode areas
and the limits of analysing vehicles at this scale.

- **`pca_YYYY`** is the postcode area in year YYYY, from
  2005 to 2025. Northern Ireland is coded `BT`,
  its real postcode area (older deliveries' `NI` is recoded to `BT`).
- **In a year with no recorded postcode area**, the pipeline replaces the blank
  with the vehicle's status:
  - `unborn`: the vehicle had not yet been made or registered;
  - `dead`: the year is after the vehicle's last MOT test, so it is no longer
    observed. This is not the same as scrapped: it includes vehicles exported,
    declared off the road or simply no longer tested;
  - `unknown`: the vehicle existed but was not observed, for example in its
    first three years before the first MOT.

The status rules are set out in the methodology,
[section 3.3](../../reports/methodology.md#postcode-area-status-infill), and
how the statuses describe a vehicle's life in @sec-lifecycle. A vehicle is
*observed* in a year when `pca_YYYY` holds a real postcode area, and selecting
these vehicles is the usual first step of any analysis of a year
(@sec-vehicle-table).

The Bristol team also supplied three yearly status flags, which the pipeline
carries through to the maximal table only:

- **`is_new_vehicle_YYYY`** is Bristol's new-vehicle flag for the year, and
  **`is_intertest_YYYY`** its inter-test flag. The pipeline does not use
  them.
- **`is_end_use_YYYY`** is `TRUE` in the year of the vehicle's final MOT
  test, and only where testing has stopped. The last year in which it is
  `TRUE` gives `last_mot_year` (@sec-dd-dates), and so the years in which
  `pca_YYYY` is `dead`.

## Coverage

`pca_YYYY` is never blank, because every blank is replaced by a status, so its
coverage is the share of vehicles with a real postcode area rather than a
status. Among the vehicles on the road in a year (those that are not `unborn`
or `dead`), this share is the proportion observed, shown in @fig-dd-location.

It is about 88% through the 2010s. The vehicles on the road but not
observed are `unknown`: mostly new vehicles before their first MOT, and
vehicles that missed a test. The share falls in the final years, to 76%
in 2025: a vehicle last tested in the final two years of data
may not yet be due another test, so it stays `unknown` rather than `dead`
(@sec-pitfalls).

The three status flags are present for about 91% of
the vehicles on the road in each year (@tbl-dd-location-flags).
`is_intertest_YYYY` is `TRUE` for most of them (55%
in 2015), and `is_new_vehicle_YYYY` for 19%.
`is_end_use_YYYY` is `TRUE` for about 4% of
vehicles in a typical year, but for 21% in
2025, the last year of data.

## Values

How the values of each column change over time, for each year. Numeric columns and
dates show the minimum, lower quartile (Q1), median, upper quartile (Q3) and
maximum; other columns show the share of vehicles with each value, with the
less common values grouped as *All other values* and missing values as
*Blank*.


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

### `pca_YYYY`

Postcode area in that year (Northern Ireland is BT), or unborn / dead / unknown where Bristol supplied none. Bristol attributes a PCA to years before the first MOT (from the first test) and up to two years after the last one, so a real PCA does not mean the vehicle was tested that year.


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![Share of vehicles by value of pca_YYYY, by year.](location_files/figure-html/fig-dd-v-pca-yyyy-1.png){#fig-dd-v-pca-yyyy fig-align='center' width=1050}
:::
:::


### `is_new_vehicle_YYYY`

Bristol's new-vehicle status flag for that year, as supplied. Not used by the pipeline.


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

![Share of vehicles by value of is_new_vehicle_YYYY, by year.](location_files/figure-html/fig-dd-v-is-new-vehicle-yyyy-1.png){#fig-dd-v-is-new-vehicle-yyyy fig-align='center' width=1050}
:::

### `is_intertest_YYYY`

Bristol's inter-test status flag for that year, as supplied. Not used by the pipeline.

### `is_end_use_YYYY`

Bristol flag for that year: the year of the vehicle's final MOT test, set only where testing has stopped. Drives last_mot_year.
